fact: KNBS and the National Treasury published the 38-page Statistics Bill, 2026, which would establish the Kenya Statistics Authority in place of KNBS and repeal the Statistics Act (Cap. 112); the document is a bill, undated for signature, not an enacted law.

The document is the text of Kenya's Statistics Act (Cap. 112), assented to on 23 August 2006 and commenced on 1 February 2007, establishing the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics; this version is the consolidated revision to 31 December 2022.

KNBS's July 2025 announcement of the second statistics strategy says the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics was established through the Statistics Act of 2006 (Cap. 112, Rev. 2022) as the principal agency for official statistics and coordination of the national statistical system, and that the Act was amended in 2019 to provide for the statistics function at county level.

The Senate Standing Committee on Finance and Budget reviewed the draft Statistics Bill 2026, which would turn KNBS into the Kenya Statistics Authority, with KNBS officials on 12 October 2026 (People Daily).
